SOURCE TRANSPARENCY
Collection status describes the last published snapshot.

The included GitHub Actions workflow checks configured feeds every 30 minutes. The live server also collects every 30 minutes and starts a new check when Refresh is selected. Database updated records a content change; Last feed check records a collection attempt. Snapshot loaded records this browser’s successful download. With the live service connected, Refresh collects from publishers immediately. A static-only host can reload its latest published snapshot. Failed channels retain their previous records and last successful check.

ABOUT THE FEED

A signal is the start.
Context is what matters.

CyberWatch brings incident reports, security advisories, publisher updates, and Bangladesh cyber activity into one source-backed console.

01

Original sources, visible evidence

Official feeds are collected alongside researched incident reports. Each event links back to its sources. A vulnerability entry does not imply an organization was breached.

02

Severity with a reason

Source ratings are preserved where available. Any analyst-assessed severity is identified in the event. CISA KEV inclusion establishes known exploitation, not a CVSS score or exposure in your environment.

03

Publication time ≠ collection time

Dates and timestamps are displayed in Bangladesh Standard Time (BDT, UTC+06:00). Date-only sources keep their original calendar date. Scheduled collection runs every 30 minutes. On the live server, Refresh starts a publisher check immediately and loads the result when complete. A static GitHub Pages deployment can reload published snapshots; connect the live service for on-demand collection. Database update, feed check, and browser load times remain separate.

04

Your workspace stays in your browser

Watchlist selections are stored locally on this device. They are not synchronized between users or browsers. Export downloads the currently filtered event list as CSV.
